upload.title: Zero to Shielded in 5 videos: your first private Zcash payment | Trailer
upload.description:
Five short videos take you from no wallet to your first private Zcash payment. Set up Zodl. Get your first ZEC. Shield it. Send a private note.

Watch the series and tick your progress: https://zero-to-shielded.vercel.app

A shielded payment hides who paid, who got paid and how much. The series:
1. Wallet setup: install Zodl and back up your phrase
2. Getting ZEC: swap in the app or buy on an exchange
3. Shielding and unshielding
4. Sending and receiving: your first shielded transaction
5. Stay private: five habits

Start with episode 1.

Wallet steps are shown as labelled step diagrams with the exact button names from the Zodl app, not as drawings of the app. Every fact is sourced in docs/FACTS.md. No recovery phrase appears on screen.

Zodl was called Zashi in older guides.

Zodl: https://zodl.com/
Zodl support: https://support.zodl.com/

Video, narration and script: CC BY-ND 4.0. Repost with credit, no edits.

Scripts, narration and editing were produced with AI assistance (Kiro). Narration is a synthesised voice (Kokoro, Apache-2.0). Music is original and generated in code.
